Account / Admin Assistant Job at Itura Ventures Limited




        
    

        
        Itura Ventures Limited is a fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) company specializing in the distribution of quality consumer products. The company is a trusted distributor of leading brands, including Unilever and Nestlé, ensuring that a wide range of household and food products reach retailers and consumers efficiently.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account / Admin Assistant
Job Locations: Gbagada, Bariga, Oworo, Somolu - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Record and post daily financial transactions accurately.
	Verify sales invoices, receipts, payment vouchers, and other accounting documents.
	Receive, record, and reconcile customer payments.
	Monitor daily sales collections and ensure all payments are properly accounted for.
	Assist in daily cash and bank reconciliation.
	Maintain accurate records of customer accounts and outstanding balances.
	Assist in tracking and reconciling sales transactions with the sales department.
	Verify customer balances and investigate discrepancies where necessary.
	Prepare daily and weekly sales and collection reports.
	Assist in processing supplier and operational payments as authorized.
	Maintain proper records of expenses, receipts, and payment documents.
	Monitor petty cash transactions and maintain proper documentation.
	Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and schedules.
	Ensure proper filing and retrieval of accounting documents.
	Work with the sales, warehouse, and audit teams to resolve transaction discrepancies.
	Assist with stock-related accounting records and reconciliation.
	Support the Accountant during month-end and year-end closing activities.
	Provide required documents and information during internal and external audits.
	Ensure all accounting records are accurate, complete, and up to date.
	Report unusual transactions, errors, or financial discrepancies to the Accountant promptly.
	Perform other accounting duties assigned by the Accountant or Management.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess relevant qualifications with experience.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Candidate should be preferably Male

	Prepare complete and accurate credit applications for processing.
	Work with Credit Risk and Credit Administration to facilitate timely loan approvals and disbursements.
	Ensure facilities booked comply with the Bank's credit policy and lending guidelines.


Portfolio Management, Collections & Recoveries:


	Manage assigned customer portfolios to ensure satisfactory performance.
	Monitor customer repayment performance and identify early warning signals.
	Maintain Portfolio at Risk (PAR) at or below the Bank's approved threshold.
	Ensure Non-Performing Loans (NPL) remain within approved limits.
	Follow up on overdue obligations and implement recovery actions promptly.
	Conduct regular post-disbursement monitoring visits.
	Escalate delinquent accounts in line with the Bank's recovery procedures.


Customer Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with assigned customers.
	Conduct regular customer visits to understand customers' business needs and identify growth opportunities.
	Provide timely responses to customer enquiries and resolve service issues.


Product Marketing & Cross-Selling:


	Cross-sell the Bank's products and services to existing customers.
	Promote digital banking channels and electronic payment solutions.
	Encourage customers to adopt additional banking products based on their business needs.
	Increase product penetration within the assigned customer portfolio.


Credit Monitoring & Risk Management:


	Conduct periodic business visits to monitor customers' operations and repayment capacity.
	Ensure timely submission of monitoring reports.
	Monitor collateral and security documentation where applicable.
	Promptly report adverse changes affecting customers' businesses.
	Support recovery efforts on delinquent accounts.


Compliance & Operational Excellence:


	Ensure compliance with the Bank's credit policies, operational procedures, and service standards.
	Ensure proper completion of customer onboarding documentation.
	Comply with CBN regulations and guidelines, AML/CFT requirements, KYC standards, and other applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
	Maintain confidentiality and integrity of customer information.
	Ensure all transactions are processed accurately and ethically.


Reporting & Administration:


	Prepare and submit weekly, and monthly business activity reports.
	Maintain accurate records of customer visits, business opportunities, and pipeline activities.
	Track performance against assigned business targets.
	Provide timely market intelligence and competitor information.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Banking & Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or any other related discipline.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in Business Development, SME Banking, Commercial Banking, Marketing, Relationship Management, or a similar role.
	Demonstrated experience in liability generation and risk asset creation.
	Experience in credit origination, customer acquisition, and portfolio management.

Technical Expertise and Behavioral Competencies:

Driven by integrity, professionalism, transparency and service, we believe in educating clients before offering property opportunities, providing relevant information to help them make confident decisions.

As we grow, Bisimkha Homes is building a dynamic real estate and media-driven platform focused on property education, property discovery, strategic partnerships and exceptional client service.

Joining Bisimkha Homes means becoming part of a growing team committed to building trust, creating value and helping people make better-informed property decisions.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development & Executive Assistant 

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	Bisimkha Homes is seeking a proactive, organised and highly presentable Business Development & Executive Assistant to support business growth, relationship development and the day-to-day coordination of the CEO's activities.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and engaging organizations, securing speaking/training opportunities, following up business leads and providing executive and office support.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and engage corporate organizations, cooperatives, professional associations, clubs and other relevant groups.
	Deliver business proposals, formal letters and invitations to targeted organizations.
	Follow up consistently to secure meetings, seminars, training sessions and other business opportunities.
	Maintain an organized database of contacts, prospects and follow-up activities.
	Support the CEO in meetings, presentations, property inspections, shoots and business engagements.
	Coordinate logistics for seminars, Property Discovery Tours and other company activities.
	Receive visitors and manage basic office correspondence when required.
	Assist with scheduling, documentation, research and general administrative coordination.
	Support lead follow-up and other business development activities as required.

	Minimum of OND / HND / Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Confident and professional when approaching organizations and senior decision-makers.
	Strong follow-up, persuasion and relationship-building abilities.
	Highly organized, proactive and able to work independently.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and digital communication tools.
	Willingness to travel within and outside Abuja for business development activities.
	Previous experience in business development, marketing, sales, administration or executive assistance is an advantage.
	Real estate experience is an added advantage.
	Candidates residing around Garki, Abuja are preferable.

	We are looking for someone who is energetic, resourceful, persistent and opportunity-driven—someone who can receive a list of organizations and turn that list into conversations, meetings, training opportunities and relationships.

Salary
